Account Reconciliation: Regularly reconcile customer accounts to ensure balances are accurate and up to date. Aging Report Management: Maintain and monitor accounts receivable aging reports, following up on overdue accounts and escalating problematic cases as needed. Customer Communication: Build and maintain relationships with customers to resolve billing and payment issues, and negotiate payment plans when necessary. Credit Limits & Terms: Recommend credit limits and payment terms based on company guidelines and credit risk assessment. Dispute Resolution: Work with internal departments (sales, customer service, etc.) to resolve billing disputes and ensure smooth resolution. Reporting: Prepare regular reports on collection efforts, credit issues, and overall account status for management review. Compliance: Ensure that all credit and collection activities comply with company policies and legal regulations.
